title: SPE Java Section Named Regional Outstanding Section 2025
excerpt: We’re honored to share that SPE Java Section has been recognized as the Regional Outstanding Section 2025 for our dedication to advancing technical knowledge and supporting professional growth in the energy industry.
body:
We’re honored to share that SPE Java Section has been recognized as the Regional Outstanding Section 2025 for our dedication to advancing technical knowledge and supporting professional growth in the energy industry.

This achievement reflects the hard work, commitment, and collaboration of our entire community—members, volunteers, partners, and supporters—who continue to make SPE Java Section a vibrant hub for knowledge-sharing, networking, and innovation.

Thank you to everyone who contributes time, ideas, and passion to keep our section strong. Let’s continue to raise the bar together and create even more opportunities for our members and the wider energy community.

Here’s to another year of growth, impact, and connection! 🌟
